hook: Which country has the most time zones? Not Russia.
twist: France has 12, thanks to overseas territories; Russia and the US 11; the UK and Australia 9; Canada 5. China spans five geographical time zones and uses one.
angle: Countdown with flags and clock rings; the twist is China's single clock. One big number: 12.
why_now: Scout: most-time-zones Shorts top 31.8M (median of top 25: 0.38M) since mid-2024.
risks: Counts include overseas territories and exclude Antarctica (France has 13 with its Antarctic claim): say so on screen.
approved_by: user (launch slate, 2026-10-06: 'go ahead, do the whole process for all 12 videos')
